data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 6.1m (2020: favourable development of GBP 11.6m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 6.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.9m in respect of total Reinsurance business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 3.7m in Other direct.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was GBP 633.233m. The Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding showed a net favourable development of GBP 6.1m (a release), driven mainly by releases in Direct Third Party Liability and Reinsurance acceptances partially offset by a strengthening in Other direct. The report only explicitly states the net (after reinsurance) prior year movement; no single aggregate gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the movement note, so the reported prior-year movement here uses the net figure disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: releases of GBP 6.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 2.9m in respect of total Reinsurance business
strengthening of GBP 3.7m in Other direct
prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes
loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses, and the potential for second order COVID related losses
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is the NET (after reinsurance) favourable development of GBP 6.1m as disclosed in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. The note does not provide a single aggregate GROSS prior-year movement; class-level movements (releases of 6.6, 2.9 and strengthening 3.7) sum to a slightly different gross subtotal (c. GBP 5.8m) which indicates reinsurance effects. Therefore gross PYD is not available and NET was used as fallback. Opening reserves taken from balance sheet gross claims outstanding prior-year comparative. Mapping of 'Other direct' to 'Professional Lines' is approximate due to lack of explicit mapping in the report.
